Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the agent relied on incomplete and potentially inaccurate data extracted from search result snippets rather than successfully retrieving the full lists from the authoritative source (Box Office Mojo). After the initial scraping attempt failed (Step 2), the agent abandoned the automated retrieval of the complete top 10 lists and instead manually listed only 7 worldwide and 5 domestic movies based on limited search snippets. This incomplete dataset led to an incorrect calculation of the intersection (finding only 2 common movies) when the actual answer requires comparing the full top 10 lists, which would have revealed 6 common movies. This aligns with the error pattern of relying on indirect or partial data sources after a primary data extraction method fails.
